title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Maulana Sahab, my maternel aunt's husband gave three talaqs to my aunt but he is a very random and confused person who is at the same time deobandi, barelvi and ahl hadees too. After giving talaq he said that he intended to give one only. After that his elder brother took a fatwa (signed) of a mufti in saudi arbia who said that it is counted once only and, therefore, now he is living with my aunt. Please tell me whether the talaq was valid? if yes then what should we do now in order to make him understand as well as the family of my aunt? 2389 views Q. Janab Mufti Sahab, Asalaam Alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatahu. A certain person was angry(for a week) with his wife, in fit of rage he said talaq once(there was no witness other than himself and his wife) and left the home, when he was outside he picked up quarrel with his brother in law(wife's brother) the quarrel went on for couple of hours and he got more angry and went back home and pronounced 2 talaq's(again no witness) after which he realised his mistake and cried and weeped and claimed that he had said talaq only once the second time. He then went to the muftis and qazis in saudi arabia and narated his story to them who scolded hime for using the word talaq and told him that talaq had not happened and he can take back his wife by saying infront of two witnesses that he wants to take his wife back. In this situation i have couple of questions. -If he said talaq once and left and a duration passed(3-4 hours), he spoke to entire world about different matters and quarreled with people and came back to say talaq twice again. Does the talaq get implemented, will it be counted as talaq in one sitting(which as per my limited knowledge is two sittng). And he claimed that the intention was scare the wife so that she will obey him(listen to him). -If the husband claims that he gave talaq only twice and there are no witness and the wife says that she heard him say it thrice what should the wife do who does the sharia listen to??. 3148 views Q. assalmo alaikum my sister got married to my cousin. now she does not want to live with him. she insisted her husband that he give her talaq and she was excusing him of mehr. he said " tum aazad ho" at other moments he said "tum jisse shadi karn a chaho kar sakti ho". then he met again about 3 months later in the public place and said that he does not want to get seperated. to which my sister said that no she won't live with her and since then they are living apart. so is this khula valid? are they still in nikah?. 2970 views Q. Performing Iddat Period after three talaqs 6107 views Q. talaq soloution 2778 views Q. Can a woman return to ex-husband after obtaining Khula (talaq) within iddat period? If yes, what are the requirements as per sharia to achieve this if husband also agrees to take her back. 59692 views Q. Divorce through email 3187 views Q. My sister had gone through stomach surgery due to which the ayyam-e-haiz are extended than normal days 1593 views Q. I need help in an Islamic Issue. I am in serious trouble. I hope i can get some help here. I would like to know certain things about how i can get dicorced from my husband. I am from India and after marriage i went to Bangladesh with my husband. I was married in the year 2003 , i have 2 kids. My husband tortured me very badly for all these years, he did not let me talk to my parents in India and tortured me in every possible way. Two years before somehow i managed to convince him to take me to India. We came to live in our parents house he tortured me here also. I told me parents about the matter but they are not ready to support me and they want me to continue to stay with him. My parents are planning to get me settled with my husband in India forcefully but i don't want to stay with him. After sufferring his tortures all these years i do not want to stay with him and want to get divorce from him , but he is not ready to give me divorce. When we were in Bangladesh he has said that he gives me divorce many times , he has also told other people that he has given me divorce, which i think is a valid divorce in islam. My parents are not ready to accept that he has given me divorce and want me to go with him. He also says that he has never given me talaq whenever i try to tell my family members. He lies all the times and does not agree that he has given me talaq. How can i get seperated from him legally and by islamic rules please help me. All the years i stayed with him i did not let my parents know about his torture because i was afraid about my parents dignity would get spoiled. I gave him many many chances but he did not stop his torture. We are staying seperately from the last two years but he keeps coming here and keep creating problems. Please suggest the fastest and easiest way for me to get divorce from him. I have given him many chances to improve his behavious towards me but he has failed to do and continued to torture me in every possible way. Please suggest a way. Allah Hafiz 2764 views Q. Talaq on paper is valid or not. 7423 views Q. My Sister was divorced recently (Qula) and the people of society and relatives settled the matter with proper qula. Should and can my sister claim and also get all her belongings and also the gifts of her marriage and gift of husband given during marriage? 2109 views Q. I was married on Feb 16,2003 and came back to Arab for job to-date I did not go to India due to my job and passport problem. Allah bless us baby boy on Dec 20,2003. In Feb 2004, I lost the job and my inlaws started blaming me that I am married in Saudia. I sent to my wife money several times till June 2004 but after that she refused to take money, the reason was wrong concept of my marriage. After that she left the town and settled in Delhi without my consent and started Diploma in Beauty Parlor course. She came back again to home town in her mother home in July 2005, then I sent her money but she again refused. In Dec 2005, she left to Pakistan without my consent and came back after several months. In July 2006 she called me very nicely I pardoned her and we started talking till Aug 26, 2006. On Sept 13, 2006, She left to Africa along with my three old son without informing me. Her African uncle promised me to send wife/ son to me. She talked nicely from Nov 7 to Dec 2 2006. And suddenly she filed a in Jamiat Ulema Africa for Khula. The main point the wife raised that I am not in touch with her for three years and neither send her money. (Is her maintenace claim valid if she is running here/there in different countries without informing me). They are denying any conversation between Nov 7,2006 to Dec 24,2006 by saying that the voice can be developed on computer in fraud way. The last money I sent her on Aug 6, 2005 because after that she refused to accept. She want to keep son with her. My question is that on this ground our nikah will remain valid or it will finish. I want my wife and son with me as per Quran/ Sunnah. 1954 views Q. I need to clear my view against talaaq or divorce. My mummy was pregnant and my dad has left my mummy at my maternal grandfathers home and after 2-3 days he sent a letter thru his freind and in that letter he had written that i am ending our marriage and hereby give you all the three talaaq's. and he just signed it. IS IT Right can a person give talaaq thru a letter and his child is in the womb of his wife. Please clarify. 1688 views Q. Iddah 1883 views Q. Do uttering the word Talaq thrice at one go can be considered talaq in the light of Quaran and Hadidh? 2867 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 37679 Country: India Title: My sister had gone through stomach surgery due to which the ayyam-e-haiz are extended than normal days Question: My sister had gone through stomach surgery due to which the ayyam-e-haiz are extended than normal days (no more regular periods are coming after operation). During this period, she has got talaq. Now the question here is, whether the iddah duration calculated will be 3 haiz (which would be 5-6 months in this case)? Or it can be calculated based on normal haiz days, i.e. approximately 3 months? Answer ID: 37679 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 779/779/M=1433) In the question mentioned above, the iddah of your divorced sister shall complete after three haiz (menstruation cycle) though it completes in five or six months. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
